page.overview:
Who is Kollector?

Kollector is a character in the Mortal Kombat fighting game series. A debt collector, he serves as the personal banker for Shao Kahn to help fuel his tyrannical rule of Outworld.

Kollector made his debut in Mortal Kombat 11, serving as a minor antagonist in the game's Story Mode.

Kollector reappears in Mortal Kombat 1 as a NPC, serving as the shopkeeper in the game's Invasion mode.

Kollector is the uncaring and rapacious tribute collector of Shao Kahn. Despite being subservient to his master, he is consumed by greed, caring only for his own wealth and status and will kill anyone who dares challenge it. Though he was born into poverty, he was raised through the ranks and was eventually able to reach the position he holds now.
